data.body: Cutting rebar 0.13.0 release (ticket hyperbolic-pernicious-drongo / c066-c496-7012-4a39). Filed and confirmed-fixed bug loathful-unanarchic-chickadee (c21f-6f29-5d2d-4a5a): claim gate hard-rejected cross-environment plan-review op-certs (foreign_key) even though verify.require_environment/opcert_enforce_since were unset; fixed upstream in commit 3bde5613718c 'Stop gating op-certs on signing environment'. Rebased release worktree ../release-0.13.0 (branch release-0.13.0) onto origin/main @ 4d1567206fb4 (40 new commits, incl. the fix and a new uv==0.12.7 pin via scripts/check_uv_pin.py). Version-bump changes (pyproject.toml, server.json, uv.lock, CHANGELOG.md retitle Unreleased->0.13.0) auto-merged cleanly on top; new CHANGELOG entries from the 40 commits landed correctly under the 0.13.0 section with a fresh empty Unreleased. Updated local uv 0.7.18->0.12.7, recreated .venv, make install. Re-verified after rebase: uv lock --check OK; release_guards.py version-lockstep OK; pytest tests/unit/test_release_guards.py tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py -- 40 passed; make lint OK; make typecheck OK (687 files). make test (full suite) started but stopped mid-run to pause at operator request -- not yet completed. Nothing committed or pushed; no Gerrit change opened.
